title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 10-Inch Solid Brass Pullout Rod Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch Wall Mount
description:
Add convenient hanging space that disappears when not in use with this retractable hooks and garment rod. The wall mount pullout rod extends to provide a handy place to hang garments or towels, then retracts neatly for a cleaner look—ideal for traditional bathroom hardware, laundry areas, or dressing spaces.

Highlights:
- Retractable pullout design adds hanging space while saving room when retracted
- Installs in an end wall or door frame with concealed screw mounting for a refined look
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Includes brass rod, rod housing, and installation hardware
- Available in multiple lifetime designer finish options, including statement colors

Specs:
- Projection/Length: 10-Inch
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Note: Requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Pullout Garment Rod
_previous.description: Enjoy the convenience of this pull out garment rod in many places around your home. Rod installs in an end wall or door frame and retracts when not in use. When the rod is extended it provides a handy place to hang your garments or towels. Great in a laundry area, dressing area or in the bathroom. Garment rod requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract. Crafted of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
